span.p:
1. Set up
git clone, then: make setup

color: rgb(13, 101, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3. Offline tests
make test (no GCP needed)

div.style: color: rgb(23, 78, 166) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. Explore the leaderboard
make ui, open http://localhost:8080

div.style: color: rgb(23, 78, 166) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 78, 166) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. Iterate on val
shelf-bench run -a my_approach
-m gemini-3.5-flash-lite --split val --limit 5

div.style: color: rgb(13, 101, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Steps look right
in the UI?

div.style: color: rgb(13, 101, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7. Add an offline test in tests/test_<task>.py
make lint && make test

span.p:
8. Benchmark on Cloud Run
make cloud A=my_approach

results pulled into results/, commit them
